<script>
(() => {
  const quadrants = [...document.querySelectorAll('.home-quadrant')];

  const syncQuadrantTerrain = (quadrant) => {
    const tile = quadrant.querySelector('.quadrant-tile');
    const rect = quadrant.getBoundingClientRect();
    tile.style.setProperty('--terrain-x', `${-rect.left}px`);
    tile.style.setProperty('--terrain-y', `${-rect.top}px`);
  };

  const syncTileTerrain = () => quadrants.forEach(syncQuadrantTerrain);

  quadrants.forEach((quadrant) => {
    quadrant.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => syncQuadrantTerrain(quadrant));
    quadrant.addEventListener('focusin', () => syncQuadrantTerrain(quadrant));
  });

  syncTileTerrain();
  requestAnimationFrame(syncTileTerrain);
  window.addEventListener('load', syncTileTerrain, { once: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', syncTileTerrain, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('scroll', syncTileTerrain, { passive: true });
  document.fonts?.ready.then(syncTileTerrain);

  const grid = document.querySelector('.quadrant-grid');
  if (grid && 'ResizeObserver' in window) {
    new ResizeObserver(syncTileTerrain).observe(grid);
  }
})();
</script>
